five_view_layout.observation: Exactly five complete views in four rows: right, left, top, front and rear, with white gutters.

identity_and_graphics.observation: Green FYG14 identity, black chrome-lipped wheels, straight twin stripes, green molded headlights and printed rear lamps are recognizable; fine-marking limitations are recorded.

opposite_side_identity.observation: Fuel flap appears only on the right side, no left fuel flap; rear exhaust is at vehicle-left.

front_rear_cameras.observation: Front panel exposes a broad hood surface; camera must be reviewed/corrected before production use.

cross_view_consistency.observation: Same general casting, color and livery across five panels, but camera projection and fine logo orientation are not exact.

limitations: Both side rows retain visible front-bumper faces and fail the strict perpendicular-camera requirement.
The bottom front view shows a broad hood surface; it is not accepted as a strict level frontal projection.
No complete vertical overhead source: top projection and concealed relief are inferred from real oblique photos; visible hood/roof markings are documented.
Tiny hood/rear logo geometry, lettering orientation and reflections are approximate, not an exact texture transfer.
This is synthetic photographic reference with baked lighting, not calibrated CAD or neutral albedo. No Tripo submission or 3D reconstruction test was performed.
review.selection_rationale: Retain attempt 2 of three source-only generations as the best draft: correct side-specific fuel flap and good materials/background. Attempt 3 still failed the camera gate and added an incorrect left fuel flap and rear-deck stripes. No generated sheet was used as an input; discarded attempts are not retained in the clean repository.
